correctness.rationale: Unit quadratic residues modulo p^2 split into h=(p-1)/2 full residue fibers of size p, with Hensel lifting every nonzero square modp. For p>=7, partition into p layers each containing one lift of every quadratic-residue fiber. Writing k=qh+r with q=floor((k-3)/h) and 3<=r<=h+2, use q complete layers and three partial layers of sizes 1<=t_i<=h-1 totaling r; for k<=N/2 there are <=p-1 used layers. Dias da Silva-Hamidoune gives |Sigma_{t_i}(H)|>=h and Cauchy-Davenport gives total modp coverage (3h-2=p). A selected fiber multiplicity c with 1<=c<=p-1 may be translated by p*u, yielding every lift of each residue. Complementation covers N-k. The restricted two-square character formula and -1 quadratic character decide k=2, with all equal-reduction pairs liftable distinctly. p=3 and p=5 are explicitly exhausted by fiber counts, including exactly three missing residues for k=5 mod25. Independently computed ALL distinct subset sums for every k and all residues at p=3,5,7,11,13,17,19,23, confirming the full finite spectra. This does not constitute an all-primes proof without the construction.

value.rationale: The exact restricted-sum coverage spectrum of a canonical multiplicative subgroup of a prime-square ring is a natural additive-combinatorics classification. It has a stable universal-cardinality interval, arithmetic two-summand boundary and exceptional noninterval midpoint gap with exact forbidden targets. It gives a constructive lifting mechanism beyond a general sufficient bound.

final_claim: For unit squares Q_p modulo p^2, odd primes: no k is universal when p=3; exactly k=4,6 universal when p=5 and k=5 misses precisely 0,10,15 mod25; when p>=7, universal k exactly 3..N-3 and k=2,N-2 iff p≡1 (mod4), with N=p(p-1)/2.
limitations: Only odd primes and nonzero squares modulo p², with distinct summands.
General Galois rings/higher powers or nonunit squares are not classified.
